why: Reverts issue #536's inversion, leaving the puff as the refusal-only cue it was as #356's `smoke` arm. That is the SHAPE A READER EXPECTS from the file's history, which is what makes it worth pinning: a refusal reads as smoke coming out WRONG only because smoke is what every ordinary shot already produces, so a puff that appears exclusively when a shot is refused is a cue to be learned rather than a spoiled version of something familiar -- the exact design the owner ruled against, and the same reversion barrel-recoil-only-on-a-refusal guards for the recoil.
